### The Handwriting on the Wall
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/handwriting-wall
Passage: Daniel 5:26-28
Points:
- Babylon persisted in idolatrous polytheism despite repeatedly witnessing the true God's power through Daniel.
- Belshazzar committed blatant sacrilege by drinking from the sacred Jerusalem temple vessels to praise false gods.
- God's inscription signaled that Belshazzar was weighed, found deficient, and destined to lose his kingdom.
- Earthly powers may conquer nations, but the sovereign Lord rules over every worldly empire.
- God often uses the humble and marginalized to reveal truth to rulers who believe they are invincible.
